build_seq2seq_model: build a seq2seq model with encoder, decoder, discriminator, and language model components
create_encoder: create an encoder module that encodes sentences into latent states using LSTM layers
create_decoder: create a decoder module that generates word scores from encoded latent states using LSTM
generate_sentence: generate a sentence from an encoded latent state using greedy or sampled decoding
get_init_state: get an initial LSTM hidden and cell state tensor with optional non-zero first layer
